svg.text: What could run at once, and what could not
Three barriers order the whole of this work. Everything between two barriers is free to run in any order.
1 — Phase 2 delivers the store, the admission rules, the risk seam and the assembled binary; both later phases build on it.
2 — no Room can show ego's own view of vehicle B until the detector is inside the node image, so Phase 3's image step gates every Room.
3 — the account allows two deployments at once and four groups want them, so this node's two Rooms run one after the other.
Right of barrier 3 Phase 3 is still open: its last three readings are taken off the log Phase 4's first Room produced.
